## globe.gl.min.js

A pre-built bundle of [globe.gl](https://github.com/vasturiano/globe.gl)
(pinned 2.41.4), which incorporates
[three-globe](https://github.com/vasturiano/three-globe),
[three.js](https://threejs.org/) and
[h3-js](https://github.com/uber/h3-js), among other MIT-licensed modules.
One embedded module retains its own notice (MAGENTA Ltd) inside the bundle.

## countries-110m.js

Country outline geometry derived from
[Natural Earth](https://www.naturalearthdata.com/) 1:110m Cultural Vectors
(admin 0 countries), stripped to geometry and wrapped for script loading.
Natural Earth data is in the public domain: no permission is needed and no
conditions apply. Credit is given with thanks.
